tweets.text: Great work from @pushmeet  and team! Very exciting progress!

Gemini 4 Carbon is now available for users, developers and enterprises!\
\
We are heavily using Carbon internally at Google for hardest long horizon tasks, our teams have used it to help mathematically prove the core cryptographic protocol of Signal — and it’s topping independent https://t.co/bvmnYBwNp7

Announcing a major milestone achieved by my team @GoogleDeepMind: we have proven key security properties of the machine code underlying the Signal messaging protocol. This is the first time the actual production code of a widely deployed protocol has been formally verified – by https://t.co/RiYEVZD5ok

Just two weeks after rolling out Gemini 4 Argon, excited to share a preview of Gemini 4 Carbon - our next frontier model.  It has state-of-the-art long horizon coding capabilities driving SOTA performance across the cybersecurity defense lifecycle including detection, validation, https://t.co/acRuTEPmEw

We’ve seen an incredible response to Gemini 4 Argon from users, developers & enterprises: nearly 25 trillion tokens processed in the first 72 hours after launch - 3x what Gemini 3 did.\
\
Hear more about Argon and our commitment to the AI frontier from @sundarpichai ‘s conversation

New: I spoke with @sundarpichai about Google's commitment to the AI frontier, how close we are to RSI, balancing DeepMind's compute needs vs. Google Cloud profits, and much, much more. \
